name: Admin Kanban Tasks
description: Internal Kanban task board at /panel/tasks (alias /panel/tareas redirects here). Admin can create, edit, move across TO DO/In Progress/Blocked/Done columns, and delete tasks. The seven primary fields in create and edit dialogs are named by their visible labels, preserving values, validation and mouse focus (PA-236). Los encabezados siguen el idioma de la ruta. Soltar una tarjeta guarda el estado y el orden de la columna de destino.
